entry_points.text: Power entries suspend and late-restore eligible descriptors, early-restore via syscore, rearm single wakeups, drain deferred resends without the queue lock, and set boot flags for lockup detection, misroute fixup and polling.

Proc exposes affinity, list, effective, hint, node and spurious views plus default affinity, with directory and per-file roles. Affinity prefers pending moves and effective links, needs permission, enablement and online overlap, empty delegates to arch. Interrupts iterates with cached widths, header once, referenced descs or arch sentinel, releasing refs on advance/stop.

RTC backing adopts at most once among wakeup alarm devices via class interface or no-ops. Suspend snapshots freezer state and programs bounded RTC unless none or near, cancelled on resume. Rearm funnels via tick into generic program; start validates modes and resolves relative deadlines.

exports.text: MSI hierarchies offer child, parent and per-device constructors plus range, full-extent and single allocators with release, bus-based domain matching, info retrieval, isolation test and parent-init delegation.

Time services offer RTC retrieval, alarm remaining query, alarm init/start with absolute or relative deadlines, hrtimer init, saturating add, user-checked start, tick program, clock-event switch/program, monotonic now and expiry-to-cycle conversion.

hazards.text: Missing caps aborts chip assist, missing parent warns once and fails, occupied slot warns once intact. Bad control/domain fails alloc with release. Affinity needs permission, enablement, storage and online overlap. Wakeup arming needs sync; suspend enabling reversed.

Racy count/disabled sampling tolerates staleness; replay runs unlocked needing tolerant handlers; setup must not migrate; negative/suspended-start warns; zero mult repaired; hang blocks updates; minima grow to abandonment; backward deltas masked.

invariants.text: Child creation caps extent with zero meaning maximum, fills missing domain/chip hooks per flags, links as message type with firmware, bus, device and optional power. Defaults fill absent hooks, prepare clears storage with success, teardown inert, linkage records desc. Chip assist needs suppression+release or aborts; affinity installs only if absent and allowed.

Alloc needs valid control and domain, assures simple descs if flagged, prefers custom allocator else generic with release on failure; ranges from inclusive bounds, full from zero to extent-1. Alarms use enqueued marker for idempotent insert and inert remove, starting inactive.

Timers honor soft/hard with forced soft on fully preemptible unless hard asked, use monotonic for relative realtime, bind current CPU base with offset, keep laziness and usable callback. Monotonic snapshots base/cycles under sequence, scales masked deltas; conversion prechecks identity then snapshots, clamps and scales.

Scans walk active bases under mask, offset-adjust, keep smallest non-negative defaulting to far-future no-event, track soft/hard separately, ignore soft once softirq active. Reprogram stores deadline first, skips if hres inactive, hang flagged or equal excused. Start stays local if possible, honors deferred rearm, kicks remote only if local offline and first, skips if not earlier.

Program rejects negative, records even when shutdown, expects one-shot, routes hres/coupled specially, clamps tick counts with overdue failing only if not forced and minimum fallback forcing. Recovery rebases on now+minimum, retries with growth, clean on shutdown, grows small to floor and larger by half to limit with warnings.

Spurious polls each tenth second with single entry, records CPU, skips zero, racy-reads disabled-only entries, masks irqs around trials, always rearms. Attributes are status bits via helpers with reservation as proc visibility. Zero rendering uses fixed fields with 16 and 256 bulk composites, flushing trailing zeros.

locks.text: Per-type base locks guard alarm queues, freezer lock guards suspend snapshots, device lock guards selection, all irqsave. CPU base locks guard next-event scans with unlock restoring irqs. Device guard serializes install, match and public alloc/release, locked variants assume held. Desc spinlocks guard suspend/resume/affinity; time reads use sequence retry.

state_machines.text: Masking is a nesting count with matched enable and save/restore preserving state; suites need enabled setup/teardown. Expiry dequeues under base lock, calls back with base time if present, traces, never restarts; remaining is expiry minus base time.

Descs move active/marked/armed/temp-enabled via suspend marking/arming and restore to active, forced depth synthesizing disabled, early syscore vs late split. Domains absent-to-installed only after all checks, else absent. Devices span detached/shutdown/periodic/one-shot/stopped with forced clearing; reprogram normalizes, tracks soft, refuses cross-CPU/later/deferred.

structs.text: VIRQ reservation is one and activation two. Proc defaults precision four, chip width eight, headers off; name limits 128 and 11; arch sentinel address; actual-count alias; dir irq with default affinity 644; spurious totals; four affinity selectors 0-3; deferred spurious top bit of 32; unique proc header guard.

Tables offer translate/activate/release/alloc/deactivate/debug with message defaults for number/init/prepare/teardown/linkage. Parent stores ops, marking, extent, bus; child/device bundles store info, device, bus, extent, chip, ops, private, naming. Alarm bases, per-CPU aggregates, clock bases with offsets/queues, clock-event devices and timekeeper state complete layouts.
